defect_summary: After RELEASE:AWAIT publication, the producer session did not resume when GitHub Release v0.7.0 already existed.
unsuitable_process: The executor prints AWAIT publication and exits 0 with no wake. The release skill does not subscribe to GitHub Release existence. A CI subscription on branch v0.7.0 cannot observe publication. ADR 0049 OBSERVE_PUBLISH expects a resume, not an unattended wait.
climb_steps: Session stayed silent until a human poke about 90 minutes after publication.
execute.sh AWAIT exits 0 and says resume with ./release.
Skill has no Release-event or timer wake.
ADR 0049 AWAIT/OBSERVE_PUBLISH is a planner stop that requires a resume trigger.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
